title: Κεφάλαιον Βʹ — Ὁ Κῆπος καὶ Τὰ Ζῷα
titleTranslation: Chapter 2 — The Garden and the Animals

paragraphs.label: Μέρος Αʹ — Ὁ Κῆπος (Part A — The Garden)
paragraphs.translation: There is a garden. The garden is beautiful. The farmer has the garden. The garden is small, but beautiful. The garden is near the house.

translations.es: Hay un jardín. El jardín es hermoso. El agricultor tiene el jardín. El jardín está cerca de la casa, no lejos.
translations.pl: Jest ogród. Ogród jest piękny. Rolnik ma ogród. Ogród jest blisko domu, nie daleko.
translations.fil: May hardin. Maganda ang hardin. May hardin ang magsasaka. Ang hardin ay malapit sa bahay, hindi malayo.

paragraphs.translation: There is a vegetable in the garden. The farmer plants the vegetable in the garden and takes the vegetable and eats in the house.

translations.es: Hay una verdura en el jardín. El agricultor planta la verdura en el jardín. La verdura es buena.
translations.pl: W ogrodzie jest warzywo. Rolnik sadzi warzywo w ogrodzie. Warzywo jest dobre.
translations.fil: May gulay sa hardin. Nagtatanim ang magsasaka ng gulay sa hardin. Mabuti ang gulay.

paragraphs.translation: There is a tree in the field. The tree is large. Fruits are on the tree; the fruits of the tree are beautiful. And branches are on the tree. The tree has the branches and the branches bear the fruits.

translations.es: Hay un árbol en el campo. El árbol es grande. Hay frutos en el árbol; los frutos son buenos.
translations.pl: W polu jest drzewo. Drzewo jest duże. Na drzewie są owoce; owoce są dobre.
translations.fil: May puno sa bukid. Malaki ang puno. May mga bunga sa puno; mabuti ang mga bunga.

paragraphs.translation: There is a sickle. The farmer has a sickle. So he takes the sickle and harvests the fruits from the tree and carries them toward the house.

translations.es: Hay una hoz. El agricultor tiene una hoz. Así que toma la hoz y cosecha los frutos del árbol.
translations.pl: Jest sierp. Rolnik ma sierp. Bierze więc sierp i zbiera owoce z drzewa.
translations.fil: May karit. May karit ang magsasaka. Kaya kumuha siya ng karit at nag-ani ng mga bunga mula sa puno.

paragraphs.translation: There is a donkey in the farmer's field. The donkey carries the stones out of the field. The donkey is good. There is also an ox in the field. The ox is great and strong.

translations.es: Hay un asno en el campo del agricultor. El asno saca las piedras del campo. El agricultor ama al asno.
translations.pl: W polu rolnika jest osioł. Osioł wynosi kamienie z pola. Rolnik kocha osła.
translations.fil: May asno sa bukid ng magsasaka. Inililipat ng asno ang mga bato mula sa bukid. Minamahal ng magsasaka ang asno.

paragraphs.translation: There is a sheep. The sheep is an animal. And the animals are in the field. The sheep stays in the field and eats the grass of the field and drinks from the river.

translations.es: Hay una oveja. La oveja es un animal. Y los animales están en el campo. El agricultor guarda a sus animales en el campo.
translations.pl: Jest owca. Owca jest zwierzęciem. Zwierzęta są na polu. Rolnik strzeże swoich zwierząt na polu.
translations.fil: May tupa. Ang tupa ay hayop. At ang mga hayop ay nasa bukid. Binabantayan ng magsasaka ang kanyang mga hayop sa bukid.

paragraphs.translation: The sheep has a lamb. The lamb is the offspring of the sheep and is small. And the lamb runs quickly in the field. The farmer sees the lamb and the sheep in the field and rejoices.

translations.es: La oveja tiene un cordero. El cordero es cría de la oveja y es pequeño. Y el cordero sigue a la oveja.
translations.pl: Owca ma jagnię. Jagnię jest potomkiem owcy i jest małe. Jagnię podąża za owcą.
translations.fil: May kordero ang tupa. Ang kordero ay anak ng tupa at maliit. At sumusunod ang kordero sa tupa.

paragraphs.translation: The river flows near the field. And across the river there is a wild beast. The wolf is a wild beast. The wolf is large. The farmer sees the wolf across the river. He does not rejoice.

translations.es: El río fluye cerca del campo. Y al otro lado del río hay una bestia salvaje. El animal salvaje es un lobo.
translations.pl: Rzeka płynie blisko pola. Po drugiej stronie rzeki jest dzikie zwierzę. Tym dzikim zwierzęciem jest wilk.
translations.fil: Umaagos ang ilog malapit sa bukid. At sa kabilang dako ng ilog ay may mabangis na hayop. Lobo ang mabangis na hayop.

paragraphs.translation: For the wolf sees the lamb and the sheep in the field. The ox is great and strong, but the lamb is small. The wolf does not look at the ox, but the lamb.

translations.es: Pues el lobo ve al cordero y a la oveja en el campo. El buey es grande y fuerte, pero no puede ver al lobo.
translations.pl: Wilk widzi jagnię i owcę na polu. Wół jest duży i silny, ale nie może zobaczyć wilka.
translations.fil: Kita ng lobo ang kordero at tupa sa bukid. Malaki at malakas ang baka, ngunit hindi nito makita ang lobo.

paragraphs.label: Ὁ Γεωργὸς Λέγει — The Farmer Speaks
paragraphs.translation: The farmer says: 'I have a beautiful garden near the house. There is a vegetable in the garden. I also have the great tree in the field. On the tree there are fruits and branches. I take the sickle and harvest the fruits from the tree. The donkey carries the fruits toward the house. The donkey is good. I also have a strong ox in the field. I have a sheep and a lamb. But now I see the wolf across the river. The wolf does not see the great ox; he sees the small lamb. God is good and guards the lamb. I give thanks to God.'

translations.es: El agricultor dice: 'Tengo un hermoso jardín cerca de la casa. Hay verduras y frutas en el jardín...'
translations.pl: Rolnik mówi: «Mam piękny ogród blisko domu. W ogrodzie są warzywa i owoce...»
translations.fil: Sinabi ng magsasaka: 'May magandang hardin ako malapit sa bahay. May mga gulay at bunga sa hardin...'

paragraphs.label: Μέρος Βʹ — Ὁ Λύκος (Part B — The Wolf)
paragraphs.translation: The day is beautiful. The sun shines in the sky. The river flows beautifully.

translations.es: El día es hermoso. El sol brilla en el cielo. El río fluye bellamente.
translations.pl: Dzień jest piękny. Słońce świeci na niebie. Rzeka pięknie płynie.
translations.fil: Maganda ang araw. Sumisinag ang araw sa langit. Maganda ang agos ng ilog.

paragraphs.translation: The sheep eats the grass of the field. The lamb runs on the grass and rejoices. The ox stays in the field. The farmer sits outside the house and rests.

translations.es: La oveja come la hierba del campo. El cordero corre sobre la hierba y se alegra. Y el asno come la hierba junto al árbol.
translations.pl: Owca je trawę z pola. Jagnię biega po trawie i cieszy się. Osioł je trawę przy drzewie.
translations.fil: Kumakain ang tupa ng damo sa bukid. Tumatakbo ang kordero sa damo at nagagalak. At kumakain ang asno ng damo sa tabi ng puno.

paragraphs.translation: The wolf stays across the river and sees the sheep and the lamb. For the wolf wants to seize the lamb and eat it. The wolf is evil.

translations.es: El lobo permanece al otro lado del río y ve a la oveja y al cordero. Pues el lobo quiere comer el cordero.
translations.pl: Wilk pozostaje po drugiej stronie rzeki i widzi owcę i jagnię. Wilk chce bowiem zjeść jagnię.
translations.fil: Nananatili ang lobo sa kabilang dako ng ilog at tinitingnan ang tupa at kordero. Gusto kasi ng lobo na kainin ang kordero.

paragraphs.translation: The sheep and the lamb do not see the wolf. For the sheep eats the grass and the lamb runs on the grass.

translations.es: La oveja y el cordero no ven al lobo. Pues la oveja come la hierba y el cordero corre sobre la hierba.
translations.pl: Owca i jagnię nie widzą wilka. Owca bowiem je trawę, a jagnię biega po trawie.
translations.fil: Hindi nakikita ng tupa at kordero ang lobo. Kumakain kasi ang tupa ng damo at tumatakbo ang kordero sa damo.

paragraphs.translation: The farmer sees the wolf across the river and does not rejoice. For the farmer loves the sheep and the lamb. He is therefore about to save the sheep and the lamb from the wolf.

translations.es: El agricultor ve al lobo al otro lado del río y no se alegra. Pues el agricultor ama a sus animales.
translations.pl: Rolnik widzi wilka po drugiej stronie rzeki i nie cieszy się. Rolnik bowiem kocha swoje zwierzęta.
translations.fil: Nakikita ng magsasaka ang lobo sa kabilang dako ng ilog at hindi siya nagagalak. Minamahal kasi ng magsasaka ang kanyang mga hayop.

paragraphs.translation: For the good farmer does not abandon his animals and flee from the wild beast. But he stays and guards his animals.

translations.es: Pues el buen agricultor no abandona a sus animales y no huye de la bestia salvaje. Así que agarra rápidamente su vara.
translations.pl: Dobry rolnik bowiem nie porzuca swoich zwierząt i nie ucieka przed dzikim zwierzęciem. Szybko więc chwyta swój kij.
translations.fil: Hindi kasi iniiwanan ng mabuting magsasaka ang kanyang mga hayop at hindi tumakatakbo mula sa mabangis na hayop. Kaya mabilis na sinagit niya ang kanyang tungkod.

paragraphs.translation: And look! The wolf runs into the river and comes out of the river into the field. Now he is near the lamb. For he wants and is about to seize it.

translations.es: ¡Y mira! El lobo corre hacia el río y sale del río hacia el campo. El agricultor lo ve y corre rápidamente hacia el lobo.
translations.pl: I patrz! Wilk biegnie do rzeki i wychodzi z rzeki na pole. Rolnik widzi go i szybko biegnie ku wilkowi.
translations.fil: At tingnan! Tumatakbo ang lobo patungo sa ilog at lumalabas mula sa ilog papunta sa bukid. Nakikita ito ng magsasaka at mabilis na tumatakbo patungo sa lobo.

paragraphs.translation: The lamb does not see the wolf. But the donkey hears the wolf and cries out. Immediately the farmer takes his rod. He also takes stones from the field. He runs into the field and cries out with a great voice. He throws the stones at the wolf.

translations.es: El cordero no ve al lobo. Pero el asno oye al lobo y grita. Inmediatamente el agricultor oye la voz del asno.
translations.pl: Jagnię nie widzi wilka. Ale osioł słyszy wilka i krzyczy. Rolnik natychmiast słyszy głos osła.
translations.fil: Hindi nakikita ng kordero ang lobo. Ngunit naririnig ng asno ang lobo at sumisigaw. Agad na naririnig ng magsasaka ang boses ng asno.

paragraphs.translation: He cries out again and says: 'Go away from the field!' The wolf hears the farmer's voice and sees the stones and the rod. He is no longer about to seize the lamb. He does not want to stay in the field. So he flees from the lamb toward the river.

translations.es: Grita de nuevo y dice: '¡Vete del campo!' El lobo oye al agricultor y ve la vara. Pero no se va inmediatamente.
translations.pl: Krzyczy znowu i mówi: «Odejdź z pola!» Wilk słyszy rolnika i widzi kij. Ale nie odchodzi natychmiast.
translations.fil: Sumisigaw muli siya at sinasabi: 'Umalis sa bukid!' Naririnig ng lobo ang magsasaka at nakikita ang tungkod. Ngunit hindi agad umaalis.

paragraphs.translation: The farmer pursues the wolf and cries out again and throws stones again. Finally the wolf flees across the river.

translations.es: El agricultor persigue al lobo y grita de nuevo y lanza piedras de nuevo. Finalmente el lobo huye del campo.
translations.pl: Rolnik ściga wilka i znowu krzyczy i znowu rzuca kamieniami. W końcu wilk ucieka z pola.
translations.fil: Hinahabol ng magsasaka ang lobo at sumisigaw muli at naghahagis ng mga bato muli. Sa wakas tumakas ang lobo mula sa bukid.

paragraphs.translation: The farmer stays in the field and sees his animals. The sheep eats the grass. The lamb runs on the grass. The ox stays in the field. The donkey rests. Therefore the farmer rejoices.

translations.es: El agricultor permanece en el campo y ve a sus animales. La oveja come la hierba. El cordero está cerca de la oveja.
translations.pl: Rolnik pozostaje na polu i widzi swoje zwierzęta. Owca je trawę. Jagnię jest blisko owcy.
translations.fil: Nananatili ang magsasaka sa bukid at tinitingnan ang kanyang mga hayop. Kumakain ang tupa ng damo. Malapit ang kordero sa tupa.

paragraphs.label: Ὁ Γεωργὸς Εὐχαριστεῖ — The Farmer Gives Thanks
paragraphs.translation: So the farmer sits on the stone under the tree and gives thanks to God. He says: 'O Lord my God. I give thanks to you. You are righteous and faithful. You love me and my animals. Today you guard me and my animals. The wolf wants to seize the lamb, but you save it from the wolf. You are great and good.'

translations.es: Así que el agricultor se sienta en la piedra bajo el árbol y da gracias a Dios. Dice: 'Dios es bueno y fiel...'
translations.pl: Rolnik siada więc na kamieniu pod drzewem i dziękuje Bogu. Mówi: «Bóg jest dobry i wierny...»
translations.fil: Kaya umupo ang magsasaka sa bato sa ilalim ng puno at nagpapasalamat sa Diyos. Sinabi niya: 'Ang Diyos ay mabuti at tapat...'

paragraphs.translation: Then the farmer calls the sheep and the lamb. The sheep knows the farmer's voice. The lamb also knows his voice. For they hear his voice every day.

translations.es: Entonces el agricultor llama a la oveja y al cordero. La oveja conoce la voz del agricultor y sigue al agricultor.
translations.pl: Potem rolnik woła owcę i jagnię. Owca zna głos rolnika i podąża za rolnikiem.
translations.fil: Pagkatapos tinawag ng magsasaka ang tupa at kordero. Kilala ng tupa ang boses ng magsasaka at sumusunod sa magsasaka.

paragraphs.translation: So the farmer lifts the lamb and carries it. The sheep follows. The donkey carries the fruits of the tree. They go out of the field. The farmer leads his animals toward the house.

translations.es: Así que el agricultor levanta al cordero y lo carga. La oveja le sigue. El asno lleva las frutas.
translations.pl: Rolnik więc podnosi jagnię i niesie je. Owca podąża za nim. Osioł niesie owoce.
translations.fil: Kaya itinaas ng magsasaka ang kordero at dinala ito. Sumusunod ang tupa. Dinadala ng asno ang mga bunga.
